scripts.dev: npm run build -w @launchpad/shared && npm run build -w @launchpad/contracts && cross-env APP_MODE=demo concurrently -k npm:dev:web npm:dev:api
scripts.dev:live: npm run build -w @launchpad/shared && npm run build -w @launchpad/contracts && cross-env APP_MODE=live concurrently -k npm:dev:web:live npm:dev:api npm:dev:worker
scripts.build: npm run build -w @launchpad/shared && npm run build -w @launchpad/contracts && npm run build -w @launchpad/api && npm run build -w @launchpad/worker && npm run build -w @launchpad/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @launchpad/shared && npm run build -w @launchpad/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @launchpad/shared && npm run test -w @launchpad/shared && npm run test -w @launchpad/contracts && npm run test -w @launchpad/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build -w @launchpad/shared && npm run test:e2e -w @launchpad/web
